singapore.title: Flag of Singapore
desc: - Red and white horizontal halves with a white crescent moon and five stars in the upper hoist
- The five stars represent democracy, peace, progress, justice, and equality
trivia:
- The crescent moon represents a young nation on the rise; the stars represent ideals of democracy and unity
- The red represents universal brotherhood and equality; the white represents purity and virtue
- Singapore adopted this flag in 1959 when it gained self-governance from Britain
